name: Tseda
tagline: Describe a disease or draw a molecule and get generated drug candidates to explore.

awards: Best Machine Learning Track Hack - Bitcamp

solution: A language model proposes candidate compounds, a chemistry model evaluates them, and a drawing tool lets users edit structures.
demo_moment: Team-described: request candidates for a disease and refine one.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Machine Learning Track Hack - Bitcamp” among 223 submissions.
Combines generation with a chemistry model.

lessons: Pair a generator with a domain evaluator.
